author: outlander79
quote: A true corruption and perversion of what made the gta franchise great to begin with and a spit in the face to long time fans and gamers in general. Purely made to be as safe and as spineless as possible, to not offend anyone and appeal to the lowest common denominator in which I am sure it has succeeded. This is not a game made by or for people with real passion for gaming, it is made by a megacorporation concerned only with profits, and continues the trend of western AAA gaming's decline. Actual literal slop that reeks of HR board meeting humor and lifetime TV tier writing.
